First, note: Asia/Riyadh = UTC+3, Asia/Singapore = UTC+8 (historically consistent for modern time zone questions unless specified otherwise).  

Time in Riyadh: 12:00 (12 PM), Nov 13, 1041, UTC+3.  
UTC = 12:00 − 3 hours = 09:00 UTC, Nov 13, 1041.  
Singapore time = 09:00 UTC + 8 hours = 17:00, Nov 13, 1041.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 17:00
